_about: Expected scanner findings for the curated fixture. Hand-authored from the rules in CONTEXT.md; this is the contract the scanner must satisfy. Paths are relative to the library root 'Audiobooks'. Read this file alone to know every expected finding: you do not need to walk the tree or open the example-nas snapshot. `config` is the configuration the whole output assumes; `excluded` lists folders an exclusion rule drops and prunes; `notes` holds assertions not tied to one folder.

The ancestor-coverage cases (Cixin Liu, Earthsea) and the AppleDouble-only-ebook case (The Martian) are synthetic: the real snapshot has no such instance, so these defend the spec rule rather than reproduce observed data.

James Clear/Atomic Habits (Unabridged) is synthetic: the snapshot has '(Unabridged)' only in file names, never folder names. It guards that the abridged exclude glob **/*(abridged)* does not over-match the substring 'abridged' inside 'unabridged'; the folder must be flagged, not excluded.
